metadata.title: How a Curative Title Investor Finds & Solves Deals Others Can't
metadata.author: Courtney Fricke
metadata.shortDescription:
What does curative title investing actually look like beyond buying partial interests from heirs?

In this episode of the Messy Money Podcast, I sit down with longtime curative real estate investor Karl Spielvogel to break down how he finds, researches, and solves messy real estate deals that other investors often overlook.

If you're a real estate investor, wholesaler, or agent interested in curative title, complicated ownership, distressed property, or the messy side of real estate, this conversation will give you a much broader look at what's possible.

ATTENTION:

The information shared in this episode is for educational and informational purposes only and reflects personal experiences and opinions. It is not intended as legal, tax, financial, or investment advice. Real Estate laws, tax rules, and regulations vary by state and situation. Always consult with a qualified attorney, CPA, or other licensed professional before making any Real Estate or financial decisions.

Business Line: 70(four)-777-7777 — Call and leave a message

YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@courtneyfricke
Website: www.CourtneyFricke.com

Join Curative Title Investing Facebook Group: https://www.facebook.com/groups/curativetitle 

Louisiana Real Estate Talks Podcast: https://www.youtube.com/@LouisianaRealEstateTalks 

Subscribe to the Messy Money Podcast for real-world conversations about combining curative title and creative finance to solve the messy problems that keep good real estate deals from getting done. And if you know an investor who could benefit from looking at complicated deals differently, share this episode with them.
